schema_sql: CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_run ON candidate_models (federation_run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_clientstatus_run_client ON fl_client_statuses (run_id, client_id, round_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conn_device_time ON device_connections (device_id, at_us)
CREATE INDEX ix_context_session_seq ON context_snapshots (session_id, sequence_index)
CREATE INDEX ix_devices_user ON devices (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fedruns_user_started ON federation_runs (user_id, started_at_us)
CREATE INDEX ix_governance_candidate ON governance_decisions (candidate_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_preview_session ON waveform_previews (session_id, channel)
CREATE INDEX ix_quality_session_seq ON signal_quality_events (session_id, sequence_index)
CREATE INDEX ix_sessions_state ON monitoring_sessions (state)
CREATE INDEX ix_sessions_user_created ON monitoring_sessions (user_id, created_at_us)
CREATE INDEX ix_state_session_seq ON monitoring_state_events (session_id, sequence_index)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_fedrounds_run_round ON federation_rounds (run_id, round_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_inference_session_seq ON inference_events (session_id, sequence_index)

CREATE TABLE candidate_models (candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_model_id TEXT NOT NULL, federation_run_id TEXT NOT NULL, round INTEGER NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, client_count INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, state_digest TEXT NOT NULL, validation_status TEXT NOT NULL, governance_status TEXT NOT NULL, sandbox_status TEXT NOT NULL, production_deployed INTEGER NOT NULL, claim_boundary TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (candidate_id), FOREIGN KEY (federation_run_id) REFERENCES federation_runs(run_id))

CREATE TABLE context_snapshots (snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_index INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp_us INTEGER NOT NULL, hr_ecg_bpm REAL, pr_ppg_bpm REAL, spo2_pct REAL, spo2_valid INTEGER NOT NULL, context_available INTEGER NOT NULL, ppg_quality TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))

CREATE TABLE device_connections (connection_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, device_state TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_index INTEGER NOT NULL, reason_code TEXT, recoverable INTEGER NOT NULL, at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (connection_id), FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(device_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id), CHECK (recoverable IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE devices (device_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, adapter_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_dataset_id TEXT, source_mode TEXT, simulation_version TEXT, capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, scenario_id TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (device_id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id), CHECK (adapter_type <> 'SIMULATED' OR scenario_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE federation_rounds (round_pk TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, round_id INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, base_state_digest TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, accepted_update_count INTEGER NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT, updated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (round_pk), FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES federation_runs(run_id))

CREATE TABLE federation_runs (run_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_type TEXT NOT NULL, base_model_id TEXT NOT NULL, federation_protocol_id TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, secagg_mode TEXT NOT NULL, planned_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL, current_round INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, engineering_only INTEGER NOT NULL, candidate_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id))

CREATE TABLE fl_client_statuses (status_pk TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, client_id TEXT NOT NULL, round_id INTEGER NOT NULL, client_state TEXT NOT NULL, local_example_count INTEGER NOT NULL, update_digest TEXT, reason_code TEXT, updated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (status_pk), FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES federation_runs(run_id))

CREATE TABLE governance_decisions (decision_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision TEXT NOT NULL, checks_json TEXT NOT NULL, decided_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, scientific_promotion INTEGER NOT NULL, production_deployed INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (decision_id), FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES candidate_models(candidate_id))

CREATE TABLE inference_events (inference_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_index INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp_us INTEGER NOT NULL, model_id TEXT, calibration_domain TEXT, ecg_quality TEXT NOT NULL, monitoring_state TEXT NOT NULL, raw_probability REAL, source_domain_calibrated_probability REAL, threshold REAL, latency_ms REAL, context_json TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (inference_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))

CREATE TABLE monitoring_sessions (session_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, adapter_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_dataset_id TEXT, source_mode TEXT, scenario_id TEXT, scenario_seed INTEGER, simulation_version TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at_us INTEGER, ended_at_us INTEGER, model_id TEXT NOT NULL, calibration_id TEXT NOT NULL, preprocess_id TEXT NOT NULL, alert_policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, alert_policy_binding_id TEXT NOT NULL, gateway_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL, api_contract_version TEXT NOT NULL, software_system_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id), FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(device_id))

CREATE TABLE monitoring_state_events (event_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_index INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp_us INTEGER NOT NULL, monitoring_state TEXT NOT NULL, previous_state TEXT, reason_code TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))

CREATE TABLE session_summaries (session_id TEXT NOT NULL, summary_version TEXT NOT NULL, duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, windows_inferred INTEGER NOT NULL, state_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL, quality_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL, hr_min REAL, hr_mean REAL, hr_max REAL, spo2_min REAL, spo2_mean REAL, spo2_max REAL, reconnect_count INTEGER NOT NULL, disconnect_count INTEGER NOT NULL, generated_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))

CREATE TABLE signal_quality_events (event_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence_index INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp_us INTEGER NOT NULL, ecg_quality TEXT NOT NULL, ppg_quality TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))

CREATE TABLE users (user_id TEXT NOT NULL, auth_provider TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT, email TEXT, demo_mode INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id), CHECK (demo_mode IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE waveform_previews (preview_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, source_rate_hz INTEGER NOT NULL, decimation_factor INTEGER NOT NULL, point_count INTEGER NOT NULL, start_timestamp_us INTEGER NOT NULL, encoding TEXT NOT NULL, data BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (preview_id), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES monitoring_sessions(session_id))
CREATE TRIGGER trg_devices_scenario_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF scenario_id, user_id ON devices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'DEVICE_SCENARIO_AND_OWNER_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sessions_runtime_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF model_id, calibration_id, preprocess_id, alert_policy_id, alert_policy_binding_id, gateway_artifact_id, api_contract_version, software_system_id ON monitoring_sessions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'RUNTIME_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE'); END

system.claim: research prototype; simulated device; not diagnostic; no clinical claim
